verdict.rationale: Steel documents its own Credentials API ("managing Steel Credentials"), so a first-party credential store exists. Nothing in the evidence shows how stored credentials are injected into logins, any TOTP/2FA handling, or that secrets stay hidden from the model. Auth-context reuse is a separate session-persistence feature and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented automated login using vault credentials, TOTP/2FA challenge completion, guarantee that secrets are not exposed to the model, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can store credentials in a vault and have the agent complete logins including TOTP/2FA challenges without exposing secrets to the model

citations.quote: Explore API endpoints for managing Steel Credentials.
